messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-10-09T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Development engagement notice — draft for legal/HR review

Team,

I need a quick review of the attached draft I plan to send to the manager at Acme Health. The situation: their product manager (external) has had repeated missed milestones, documented coaching conversations on 6/15, 7/22, and 9/10, and last sprint had four incomplete deliverables. The manager has asked for a formal development engagement to make expectations explicit.

High-level ask:
- Legal: flag any language that could be construed as disciplinary vs developmental. Prefer wording that keeps this as a coaching/development track.
- HR (Kim): confirm the timeline below aligns with our standard remedial engagement (I propose 45 calendar days) and advise on required evidence artifacts.
- Aditya: can you confirm we have the coaching notes and QA snapshots I referenced (I attached the timeline spreadsheet).

Proposed timeline in the draft: 45-day development engagement, weekly checkpoints, success criteria, and an explicit evidence list. I marked a few paragraphs I think are risky for termination language.

Attachments: draft_engagement_notice_v1.docx (attached), evidence_timeline.xlsx (attached).

I want to get this to the Acme manager and their HR by Monday (10/11) to keep things moving. Please reply with redlines or call-out comments.

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-09T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Development engagement notice — draft for legal/HR review

Rachel — thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes inline: see attached version with tracked comments.

Top concerns:
- Remove any phrasing that suggests imminent termination; keep outcomes framed as "developmental expectations" and "objective evidence".
- Add a short paragraph about manager coaching actions (dates and content) to show good-faith effort.
- Include accommodation note (brief) to ensure we’re not missing any reasonable adjustments.

I agree 45 days is reasonable for this role; suggest weekly 30-min checkpoints and a formal mid-point review at day 21.

I attached a templated checklist I use for evidence collection.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Sr. People Partner, Redwood Inference
Attachments: draft_engagement_notice_v1_KP_comments.docx (docx), evidence_checklist_template.pdf (pdf)

Thanks Kim and Rachel. I reviewed Kimberly's comments and made two legal suggestions in the attached redline:
1) Replace any "failure to meet expectations" language that is predictive of termination with "failure to demonstrate agreed-upon outcomes during the engagement".
2) Add an explicit statement that the engagement is not a contractual amendment (keeps the paper trail clear).

Also, request Rachel confirm we have the coaching artifacts (Aditya please confirm): first-line notes, sent emails, and sprint acceptance logs. If any of those are missing, we should flag before sending.

I believe the draft is safe once Kimberly's checklist is embedded and the small language changes are made. Happy to sign off after those updates.

Laura Bennett
